reviews.review: Bought this during steam winter sale and it is great feeling rogue shooter. The movement reminds me of sunset overdrive and Doom 2016 (two of my favorites) The gun play is silky smooth and also reminds me of the new Doom games which gets nothing but praise from me. In terms of enemy design the bosses (the four i've played against) are designed with telegraphed moves with no cheap feeling deaths. They all look great and definitely had care and effort put into their design. The first phase of bosses all feel a little on the easy side just being able to beat them with the "just constantly move sideways strat" with a few jumps for Diggy Mole. With it being the first phase of bosses I don't mind it too much though. The enemy design for the grunts is great gameplay wise with each unit having a unique attack or ability. Don't know if the enemy visual design gets more varied after the 5th stage but so far its been lackluster and just seems like they have 3 or 4 enemy models and just stuck a jetpack on them, gave them different weapon, changed their color a little and called it good. With how different some of them are it would have been neat to see a whole different model for them. But again, only on the 5th stage so it could get better for all i  know.  I plan on playing it a lot more and encourage people to give it a try if you like rogue shooters. Oh, and the soundtrack is dope, the song Brilliant is easily my favorite.

This game was so much better before the major fix with stats and the change with all of that. Personally when I complete a round in a given time I want to be rewarded for the rest of the run, not rewarded with currency that can be used post game, at that point the time limit doesnt really matter because it doesn't benefit me in my current run. Other than that, the games fun, intense, and the only other issue i have is how assault weapons aren't up there with the other classes. Good game but can be made so much more with minor tweaks. currently feeling a 7/10 on it especially after the level up and the 3 slot stats, doesnt fit well in my opinion. Thats it.


EDIT: After Playing the Playtest, this game has a lot more potential especially with the ability to stack more than 3 attributes and so on, very fun and can see myself playing. The power shards and the trading is a massive massive buff. Loving the new look of the game
reviews.developer_response:
Hello there!

Giving some rewards to the rank S for your current run is something we're looking to do in the future.

However, the way it was working previously was not necessarily the proper implementation of such a reward, at least in our eyes.

We'll definitely be implementing something else, we just didn't find it yet.

We hope you'll find the game better and change your review once we do that.

Thanks for your feedback and happy new year!
